correctness.rationale: Distinct length-two paths are independent basis coordinates; each contributes exactly a 2x2 determinant. On supported components the second arrow coefficients must be scalar multiples, neighbors outside support forced zero, vertices outside closed neighborhood free, and all length-two coordinates central. Dimension subtraction yields |N[S]|-c(S), and projective-coloring gives q+1 options per supported component. Matrix and pair enumeration corroborate all tested cases.
